context: After Gortash’s death (but before Orin’s) the illithid elder brain has seized the city’s communications and is broadcasting its voice through every Steel Watcher in Wyrm’s Crossing and the Lower City. Off‑screen, a Neurocitor in the Steel Foundry links and controls the Watchers; tampering with it risks detonating collars, alerting overseers, or causing network cascades, and Gondian workers and their leader Toobin—whose collars are tied into that same system—are nearby and vulnerable. The elder brain uses the Watchers to issue a coercive order: kill Orin and eliminate witnesses, promising to “take care” of any fallout if Gortash was already slain. In response the player can reply with defiance, bargain (or attempt to win control), or plot to destroy the elder brain/Neurocitor; convincing a single Steel Watcher can sway the rest.
